title: The generalized Mukai pseudoindex assertion
exact_target: For every smooth connected complex projective Fano $n$-fold $X$ with $n>0$, Picard number $\rho$, and pseudoindex $\iota=\min\{-K_X\cdot C:C\text{ is a rational curve}\}$, is $\rho(\iota-1)\leq n$, with equality exactly when $X$ is the product of $\rho$ copies of $\mathbb{P}^{\iota-1}$?

sources.citation: OpenAI, manuscript citation page. Source of the formulation motivating this local problem.
